title: Percutaneous Transluminal Angioplasty (PTA) with Carotid Artery Stenting (CAS)
description: CMS coverage for Percutaneous Transluminal Angioplasty (PTA) with Carotid Artery Stenting (CAS) for patients with symptomatic or asymptomatic severe carotid stenosis at high risk for carotid endarterectomy (CEA). Mandatory deployment of FDA-approved embolic protection systems.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Severe Carotid Stenosis (>= 70% Symptomatic or >= 80% Asymptomatic)
criteria.description: Documented carotid artery stenosis >= 70% in symptomatic patients or >= 80% in asymptomatic patients verified by carotid duplex ultrasound, CTA, MRA, or angiography.
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish severe anatomical carotid narrowing threshold

criteria.name: Documented High Surgical Risk for Carotid Endarterectomy (CEA)
criteria.description: Patient has documented clinical or anatomical features placing them at high risk for open CEA (e.g., hostile neck, prior radiation, tracheostomy, severe COPD, STS score >= 8%).
criteria.clinical_intent: Justify percutaneous stenting over surgical endarterectomy

criteria.name: Mandatory FDA-Approved Embolic Protection Device (EPD)
criteria.description: Procedure plan includes deployment of an FDA-approved distal embolic protection device (filter or flow reversal system) during stent deployment.
criteria.clinical_intent: Prevent distal embolic stroke during stenting
